races.paceDynamic: Rocky's Howya stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will control this race from flag to finish without pressure. The prominently-raced horses like Lightkeeper, Jerandme and You Done Well will track behind but lack the tactical speed to challenge early. With numerous hold-up horses including Woodstream Lad, Spinning Web, God Of Thunder and Midnight Eagle, the pace will be steady and controlled throughout. This sustainable gallop strongly favours front runners and early prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large contingent of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Rocky Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Rocky's Howya jumps well and faces no early pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The leader dictates comfortable fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges up the hill. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic as the field bunches approaching the final flight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Lightkeeper or You Done Well apply early pressure and force a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and allows the prominently-placed horses to kick clear before the hold-up brigade can organize their runs. Class tells in the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Rocky's Howya stops to a walk in front
scenarios.body: Woodstream Lad or God Of Thunder find clear runs and power through a weakening field with superior finishing kicks. The sustained gallop suits their patient tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Long Shot
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or refused create carnage and destroy the race shape
scenarios.body: The disruption allows an outsider like Circus Act or Anysignofhim to inherit a position they could never achieve on merit. Surviving becomes more important than racing ability.

watchPoints.text: Rocky's Howya must jump cleanly at the first few flights as any early mistake hands tactical advantage to prominent trackers
Lightkeeper's fitness after 231-day break under pressure from You Done Well tracking alongside in the early stages
Traffic problems developing at the third-last flight where hold-up horses Woodstream Lad and God Of Thunder need clear runs
God Of Thunder's jumping and attitude after refusing to race last time, any repeat antics eliminates a main danger
The uphill finish testing stamina reserves of Rocky's Howya if Lightkeeper or You Done Well have applied early pressure

races.paceDynamic: Springhill Warrior, Tomthescaffolder and Welcome Back will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. This creates a demanding test of stamina over 2m3½f, with the pace likely to be strong throughout given the competitive nature between these leaders. The strong gallop will suit hold-up horses who can stay on strongly, while prominent racers may get caught between speeds. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can pick up the pieces when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and weaken significantly from 2f out
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will stretch the field and create openings for hold-up horses with stamina to sweep past tiring leaders. Minella Diamond's class and Captain Hanley's solid staying form make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders drops back early creating a more sedate tempo
scenarios.body: This allows prominent racers to position better and hold-up horses lose their advantage from a strong pace setup. It's Time To Leave and Million Dollar Man could prove too good if the pace doesn't play to stayers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Springhill Warrior gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: Elliott's charge can dictate terms and kick clear when it matters, using his class advantage. The reduced pace pressure allows his superior ability to shine through in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Sustains Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders maintain their effort to the line without weakening
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop finds out every horse's stamina reserves with only the most genuine stayers lasting home. This extreme test heavily favours proven marathon performers with recent race fitness.

watchPoints.text: Springhill Warrior could prove too classy if the break hasn't dulled his edge and he handles the step up in trip
It's Time To Leave and Million Dollar Man are complete unknowns who could have significant hidden ability
Captain Hanley has been running respectably on the flat and the step back to hurdles with headgear applied could spark improvement
The three front-runners may go too fast early and set it up perfectly for the hold-up brigade
Minella Diamond's class and experience advantage could tell if positioned to take advantage of the likely strong pace

races.paceDynamic: Ixigreczed will be the sole confirmed front-runner in this competitive handicap hurdle, likely to set a steady sustainable gallop without early pressure. With only Kilbarry Ce Ce and Thewaybackhome likely to race prominently, the majority of this 19-runner field will be held up or tracking from midfield positions. The lack of genuine pace pressure should create a searching test over this extended trip, with the race developing into a staying examination from the back of the last flight. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can finish strongly, as they'll benefit from the modest early pace and get first run on a vulnerable leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and Ixigreczed comes under pressure turning for home...
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace will suit patient hold-up performers who can quicken late over this stamina-testing trip. Proven stayers like Whiskey Serenade, Sarah's Express, and Andyourbirdcansing will have every chance to pick off the front-runner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Kilbarry Ce Ce or Thewaybackhome can track the leader without doing too much work early...
scenarios.body: Racing in the slipstream of Ixigreczed will provide the perfect position to strike when the leader weakens, avoiding both the hard early work and the traffic problems. Kilbarry Ce Ce's recent form suggests he's well-handicapped for this longer trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader lasts home
scenarios.trigger: If Ixigreczed gets an uncontested lead and finds renewed form at this longer trip...
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure could allow the front-runner to conserve energy for a sustained finish, especially if his recent poor efforts were due to being outpaced over shorter distances. His hold-up rivals may leave their challenges too late on ground that's riding slower than ideal.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate pace backfires
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so slow that it becomes a sprint finish from the last flight...
scenarios.body: A crawling pace could negate the stamina advantages and turn this into a dash for speed horses who normally struggle over longer trips. This would particularly suit any hold-up horse with a sharp turn of foot rather than pure staying power.

watchPoints.text: Ixigreczed's jumping under pressure - if he makes mistakes when challenged he could bring down others in a bunched field.
The pace through the middle section - if it stays too steady it could set up a cavalry charge finish that favours different horses.
Kilbarry Ce Ce's position early - if he gets caught wide tracking the leader it could compromise his chance significantly.
Traffic problems at the last flight - with so many hold-up runners the run-in could get very congested.
Ground conditions deteriorating - any rain could favour different horses than current form suggests.

races.paceDynamic: Amron Diamond stands out as the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field, giving him a clear tactical advantage to dictate terms without early pressure. With most runners adopting hold-up or midfield tactics, the early pace will be moderate and sustainable, allowing Amron Diamond to build a rhythm over the 2m3½f trip. The large field of hold-up horses will create traffic problems in the home straight as they all seek racing room simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure clear runs, while the army of hold-up horses will face significant tactical disadvantages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Amron Diamond maintains his lead unchallenged through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The lone leader builds an unassailable advantage while the packed field of hold-up horses struggle for racing room in the straight. His 224-day break becomes irrelevant as tactical positioning trumps fitness concerns.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers track Amron Diamond closely and pounce late
scenarios.body: Mollys Dolly, Bite That or Listenheretomejack benefit from following the pace without setting it, then striking when the leader tires. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and stamina becomes the deciding factor
scenarios.body: Despite traffic issues, one well-positioned hold-up horse like Tedworth or Old Kenmare finds a clear passage and benefits from the strong gallop. The 2m3½f trip plays to their strengths if they avoid trouble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Outsider Win
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or significant interference disrupts the field
scenarios.body: A rank outsider like Listentomewillya or Koeur A Prendre benefits from the chaos while better-fancied horses encounter trouble. The large field and jumping test creates opportunities for unconsidered runners.

watchPoints.text: Amron Diamond could steal this from the front if the 224-day layoff hasn't dulled his fitness edge
Traffic chaos likely in the straight as 15+ hold-up horses seek racing room simultaneously
Watch Mollys Dolly and Bite That tracking the leader early as the main tactical threats
Several runners showing fading tendencies could compound traffic issues if they weaken in-running
Jockey bookings on Koeur A Prendre and Hillstar Blues suggest stable confidence despite tactical disadvantages

races.paceDynamic: Crossing The Bar will set a sustainable pace from the front with minimal early pressure, as most of this field prefers to settle behind the leaders. Penny Express, Ned In The Park, Le Kap, Colleen Danu and Ishan will track in the second rank, while the hold-up horses Oh So Charming, Arctic Flame, Le Diablo and Imarajan will settle towards the rear. With only one confirmed front-runner and plenty of prominent racers happy to sit second, this creates a tactical race run at a measured gallop until the business end. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalize on the steady early pace and time their challenges from off the speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and Crossing The Bar isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The patient riders get perfect splits as the field comes back to them over the final half-mile, with stamina telling late. Arctic Flame and Le Diablo are perfectly positioned to strike from the rear with their superior finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the front group increases the tempo from the second-last hurdle
scenarios.body: One of the prominent racers gets first run on the leaders and holds off the late challengers with superior tactical position. Penny Express or Ned In The Park use their class to quicken clear before the hold-up horses can respond.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Crossing The Bar gets an uncontested lead and the chasers leave it too late
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage turning for home as the field fails to close quickly enough. Crossing The Bar's stamina reserves prove decisive when the late challengers finally mount their bids.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise

scenarios.body: The steady early gallop becomes a messy sprint finish where any horse with a clear run can capitalize. One of the unfancied runners like Ishan or Colleen Danu sneaks through on the inside as the market leaders get shuffled back.

The prominent runners like Chautuaqua, Nirisque, and Jumbos Jet will track behind but are unlikely to apply sustained pressure given the maiden context. With many hold-up horses including Muted Melody, Our Girl Ellie, and Crossbar Getaway needing to be produced late, the pace will likely be steady rather than searching. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace without having to make ground from the rear in a competitive 18-runner field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Another Blunder leads unchallenged through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the large field. Prominent runners tracking just behind benefit from the ideal position to strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and prominent runners move forward early
scenarios.body: Horses like Nirisque and Chautuaqua get ideal racing room to build momentum and take control. The De Bromhead and Hogan yards excel in these tactical scenarios.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely run and the field spreads out significantly
scenarios.body: The backmarkers get the strong pace they need to unleash their finishing kicks. Muted Melody and Our Girl Ellie benefit from their proven ability to close strongly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Scramble

runners_data.spotlight: Back-to-back winner of modest handicap hurdles at Wexford last summer; lost form in the autumn and ran poorly at Limerick four weeks ago on his first run after a winter break; better ground could make a big difference now; only 2lb above his last winning mark.

races.paceDynamic: Expound stands alone as the confirmed leader with a sustainable style, meaning he'll dictate terms without early pressure. Five runners (Sense Of Occasion, Tingarran Express, Lady Doyanne, Theflyingbee, Tir Og, Chanceawetmorning) all want prominent positions, creating a traffic jam behind the leader with scrimmaging likely from the third-last hurdle. The hold-up quartet (Ballycashin, Eye Of A Tiger, Sonny May, Takarengo) will rely on gaps opening late as the prominent group tangles. This setup strongly favours the lone leader Expound and patient hold-up types who can exploit the prominent runners' mutual interference.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Expound uses his uncontested lead intelligently and the prominent group cancel each other out
scenarios.body: The veteran gets an armchair ride in front while five horses scrap for position behind, never mounting a serious challenge. His stamina over this longer trip proves decisive as the field comes to him tired.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates serious interference and gaps open late for patient runners
scenarios.body: The five-way battle for second position creates a stop-start pace that suits horses held up out of trouble. A strong stayer emerges from the pack with a clear run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the five prominent runners can secure an early position without getting trapped
scenarios.body: Class tells as either Lady Doyanne or Sense Of Occasion finds racing room while their prominent rivals struggle in traffic. They track Expound smoothly and outbattle him from the last.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Leader Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Expound's long absence (273 days) catches up with him in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The leader ties up badly after setting honest fractions, opening the door for whichever horse gets first run from the congested pack. Fitness issues prove costly despite the tactical advantage.
